Meng Shuyu suspected she could only ever be in “unrequited love.” When she was in love, she always cherished the person as her treasure. However, once the feelings became mutual, she couldn’t help but feel disgusted and immediately distance herself.

Finally, one day, Meng Shuyu’s dream came true.
***
To win over a person who couldn’t be in a mutual loving relationship, there were three steps:
1. Show your charm in front of her, making her unable to take her eyes away.
2. Ignore and neglect her, making her think “How could he possibly like me” and firmly believe it.

84980.synopsis:

85748.synopsis:
In the autumn of his 18th year, after winning the high school kendo championship finals, an unexpected accident occurred.
Due to that incident, Kang Mu-heon lost one of his legs, his closest friend, and his promising future. He closed off his heart and shut himself away alone.
A few years later, the world’s first real virtual reality game  was announced, where even those with physical disabilities could play in healthy bodies.
By chance, Kang Mu-heon encountered it and began a new life as the mage Kapros, facing unexpected meetings, reunions, and days of change….
***
“Why was someone like you born into this world to make me so miserable? Do you understand when I say it like this?! You were born with talent for the sword, a bright personality, everything – you must have been laughing at me always lagging behind! Did you even know how pathetic I felt because of your s*upid hypocrisy? A genius? What does any of that matter!”
Seung-jo’s cries stabbed at his heart, wailing as if he were crying even though he wasn’t, but there was no time to think further. He quickly clutched my stomach, got up, and ran towards him.
He looked surprised for a moment, but he was desperate.
Just as the car was about to reach us, he shoved Seung-jo hard. Right after Seung-jo fell and rolled away with wide, startled eyes—
Screech!
Bang! With an impact that felt like his whole body was being shattered, he flew through the air.
And in that brief yet long moment of floating in space, he remembered his reflection in Seung-jo’s eyes for the last time…….
***
[ Then in THE MIST, may you become the master of infinite possibilities. ]
Whoosh!
When his vision returned after everything went white, he was standing in the middle of a bustling town. Amidst the clamor, countless people were busily going about their business here and there.
He looked down at himself, standing dazed and wearing clothes of unknown origin. When he touched the sleeve, he felt the texture of fabric as real as reality. His hair felt the same, and even when he touched the wall of a nearby house, he could clearly feel the solid, cold surface.
Is this… VT?
It seemed like a joke. It truly felt as if he had come to another world and was touching everything.
As he stood there unable to think due to the shock, he suddenly remembered the biggest reason he had decided to play this game, and snapped back to attention. His two legs were still as they had been when he first stood.
‘Can I really walk?’
He first stepped out with his left foot, then very slowly put strength into his heavy right foot. It felt like cold sweat was running down his spine.
And then,
He lifted it,
Moved it,
And took another step to touch the ground again.
So easily. As if there had never been any problem with this leg from the beginning.
“Ah…”
At that moment, something that was neither joy nor emotion shot up his spine. Suddenly feeling a lump in his throat, he lowered his head and leaned against the wall. His right foot, bearing his weight, was doing its job perfectly.
“…”
Holding back the tightness in his throat, he took another step.
It didn’t hurt. It wasn’t heavy. His leg was no longer a useless piece of wood that ached.
Damn it, to be able to walk so easily like this.
To be able to run so easily like this.
He had wished even in his dreams for the day to come when he could walk and run like this again.
And so he walked again, kept walking, slowly getting faster, until finally he started running like a madman through the entire town.
***
“Kap. …There seems to be a misunderstanding. That’s not what I meant.”
Just as he was thinking he should throw a punch, Yu-wan sighed with a troubled look and said.
A misunderstanding? How could it be a misunderstanding when he said with his own mouth that he didn’t think of me as a friend?
“I didn’t expect to receive such a question suddenly, so my explanation was probably too brief. Let me rephrase.”
Yu-wan reached out his hand, his face completely changed from before – intense yet resolute – as he stared at him. As he didn’t reject the hand suddenly approaching his face and kept his gaze fixed, his cool large hand touched his cheek completely.

And in my belly, I was carrying Kang Yeol-Jin’s child. “Does it make any sense that I married you? Don’t touch me.

My father, who had once ruled like a king, was dead, and everything had fallen into Kang Yeol-Jin’s hands. “I’m sorry. Unlike you, I come from the gutter, right?”

When Shen Ni, the empire’s foremost machinist, returns home victorious from battle against their long-standing foe, the emperor showers her with rewards, including the hand in marriage of the woman she had loved in her youth — Bian Jin. 
Bian Jin had once been the empire’s sharpest blade: a weapon in human form whose very name made their enemies cower. After a string of near-fatal battlefield injuries, however, she’s battered, broken, and stands accused of high treason. Bian Jin claims she has no memory of what transpired, but can Shen Ni trust her? And can they trust the empire? 
Ning Yuan’s most ambitious work yet, this historical cyberpunk novel tells the story of a group of determined women whose lives become ever more intertwined as they seek to uncover secrets both past and future, and make a place for themselves in a turbulent world.

95220.synopsis:
Shen Ran, who pursued his first love and ended up with the school beauty senior, was supposed to be the envy of many. The situation took an even more awkward turn when classmates caught the two passionately kissing in a back alley.
After being dumped and humiliated, Shen Ran, in a fit of anger, went to a gay bar to experience life. To his surprise, he ran into Zhao Jiyu, a stunningly beautiful guy from his department. Known as the cold, aloof, and hard-to-pursue “male god,” Zhao Jiyu turned out to like men. In a drunken haze, Zhao Jiyu approached him and asked if he wanted to try something new.
Still upset and tipsy, Shen Ran couldn’t resist the charm of Zhao Jiyu’s alluring face. Thinking, “Why not?” he brought Zhao Jiyu back to his room. But Zhao Jiyu, with his height and physique advantage, quickly turned the tables, leaving Shen Ran as the one being dominated.
Shen Ran, holding onto Zhao Jiyu’s waistband, said: “Wait—wasn’t I supposed to be the top?”
Lifting one of Shen Ran’s legs, Zhao Jiyu smiled innocently and explained: “Yes, you’re on top… and I’m on the bottom.”
The protagonist’s first love was his senior, and they only held hands for two months.
A slight age gap, with the top being a few months younger than the bottom.

Due to her exceptional talent, a mystical system selected her, transporting her to various worlds. Her mission: complete tasks with outstanding acting skills.
Whether a pure and innocent maiden or a seductive siren, life is a stage, relying on acting prowess.
Qiao Sang’s goal is singular: captivate men, driving them crazy, and making them surrender, becoming her devoted followers.

In the book “The Exclusively Favored Imperial Concubine”, the author writes about how he slaughtered all the court of the Northern Di king, how he broke through twelve cities on the day he put on armor and rebelled, how he was cold and heartless to the bone, how he had never loved anyone in his life, and how he finally walked into the burning palace like a lone madman without looking back.

She was willing to marry her lover’s rival for the sake of her lover’s great cause, and her ending was miserable. Later, she found out that it was just that He Junting treated her differently. 
Later… she was like a lucky star, and everything went smoothly for the people around her. Wait, why are they all loving her more and more?

Fake lovers who started with the purpose of using each other, but ending up in a complicated relationship. Will the only thing left be the pain in their hearts or will they finally feel the joy of freedom?

Answer: Shower her with unconditional care, let her experience the warmth of humanity, raise her affection to the maximum, and then stage your own death in front of her…
Chen Mo transmigrated into a novel as cannon fodder, with only a little over a month left before the protagonist would kill him. But reality surprises her: a fiery mother obsessed with daughters over sons, a white lotus sister with a sister-complex, a grandmother who’s a sucker for good looks, and a younger brother brainwashed by their mother, convinced his sister is the ultimate goddess.
The family motto? “Nianbao, don’t do this! Just rest and take it easy!”

That is, until the day families visit the military camp, and he sees Jiang Nianzhi dressed in a cheongsam, red lips and jet-black hair, calling sweetly to his comrade: “Brother!”
Shen Cheng grabs his comrade by the neck. “This is the cousin you were talking about?”

……
Breaking free from the shackles of time, the prisoner shattered the cage of history.
And thus——
A player more terrifying than any boss was born.

111092.synopsis:
Di Jiang runs an apothecary at the end of South Main Street in Taiping Prefecture. However, her shop doesn’t treat humans—it heals ghosts. She has two assistants: one named Wen Yao and the other named Shu Xiang. Across the street from her apothecary is a coffin shop that specializes in resolving private debts. The owner of the coffin shop is Zhong Xu, also the seventy-second abbot of Baiyun Temple and a Taoist priest who specializes in exorcising demons. His life motto is: “All monsters must be eradicated, and no ghost shall escape punishment.”
Zhong Xu is the reincarnation of Zhong Kui, and in his past life, he shared a deep bond with Di Jiang, filled with both affection and unresolved grievances. Di Jiang is the incarnation of Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha, sent to guide and enlighten Zhong Xu. In this lifetime, they also have a close friend—Wu Rui’an, the Prince of Wu. Together, the trio travels through the mortal realm, helping Di Jiang compile The Record of the Flower Spirits. As they weave through the stories of twelve flower spirits, their bond grows stronger, ultimately leading them to reconcile past misunderstandings.
Each of the twelve flower spirits has their own unique personality traits, but they all share a common characteristic: inherent kindness. After being recorded in Di Jiang’s Flower Spirits Collection, they are able to transform their misfortunes, fulfilling the adage: “Good deeds bring good rewards.”

112116.synopsis:
Although he looks no different from an ordinary human,
Xi Yu is actually an artificial human born in a test tube—
—Costing $20,000, blessed with divine beauty, extraordinary physical and mental capabilities, no reproductive rights, and zero access to social welfare.
In this life, the only thing Xi Yu needs to do is livestream inside horror games, becoming a super-player for humans to bet on and gossip about.
But is that all there is to his fate?
No. If that were the case, you wouldn’t be reading this story.
 “Infinite-Flow Mind-Bending Game + Bonus Strong-Strong Romance Package”

113396.synopsis:
Mide Mohan, who can see the list of victims harmed by the sins people have committed.
The one who has committed the most sins is, ironically, the very person hailed as the hero who will save the continent.
Rather than watch someone like that be praised as a hero…
“I’ll do it instead. I’ll be the hero.”

118260.synopsis:
“Eyes, look at me.”
She lifted her head.
“Skirt, lift it.”
She carefully raised her skirt.
“Higher. Hold that position and don’t move.”
She cried out in shock.
“Y-Your Highness? What are you trying to do…”
“Not moving? Do you want me to do it?” 
The blood princess cast her a cold glance. 
“Remember this—you’re nothing but my plaything. You have no right to refuse me.”
And so, once again, Su Ling chose to…

119284.synopsis:
In the year 967 of Eustanville, the Emperor had lived for 336 years. Jia, having overheard whispers of the Emperor—a being who neither aged, nor died, nor suffered injury—intentionally slipped among the prisoners bound for Eustanville. Three years prior, she had been thrust into the dimension of Erendia, where she’d endured a humiliating existence as a s*ave. The Emperor represented a flicker of hope in her bleak reality.
However, the Emperor she encountered was far from what she’d imagined. He casually tortured and killed, his form splattered with blood.
“This is the first pain I’ve ever felt.” He trembled with an ecstatic thrill upon meeting Jia, his reflection. “Now you are mine.” Blood-stained fingers tightened around her cheek as chains coiled around her body, binding her to him.

119540.synopsis:
Elissa Heartnell, the eldest daughter of Marquis Heartnell, is Crown Prince Fluvio’s betrothed. Since childhood, she has dedicated herself to becoming the perfect future queen, honing her skills to compensate for Fluvio’s weaknesses—particularly his ineptitude in diplomacy. To support him, she repeatedly suspended her studies at the Noble Academy, traveling abroad to master foreign affairs, cultures, and networks.  
Then, while Elissa was overseas, news arrived: His Majesty the King has passed away.  
Rushing back, she arrives at the funeral—only to find her younger sister, Carol, clinging to Fluvio’s arm.  
“While you were gone, Carol stayed by my side. She’s the one who supported me.”  
“His Highness says he needs me. I’m sorry, Sister…!”  
Even her parents side against her, blaming Elissa for her absence—despite her sacrifices being for Fluvio’s sake.  
With icy resolve, she curtseys:  
“Understood. Your Highness, Let Me Go!”  
Now free, Elissa vows to live for herself. But as she prepares to leave the kingdom anew, a letter arrives: her parents have arranged another marriage—

124660.synopsis:
In the middle of the night, I saw a WeChat message on my boyfriend’s phone: “Old Xu, do you want a son?”
He replied with one word: “Yes!”
Then the other party sent over a pregnancy test report.
…
This is the twelfth year of our love.
He is gentle and attentive, the model husband in the eyes of all our friends.
I can’t wait to show the world how wonderful he is.
Yet, this very person, patient and gentle with me,
Is flirting with someone else, and might even have a child.

126708.synopsis:
She was no different to the livestock they kept. She was just a chambermaid in the ducal household. And the Silverdust family’s caged possession.
For thirteen years, Ines had clung to her love, enduring every insult and humiliation.
But tonight, she would end it.
“I loved you, Lucien.”
It would be just another confession that would never reach him, and that was fine.
Those three secret years of nights he would never remember would remain hers alone. She didn’t find that such a bitter thought.
Because, in the end, she would be the one to keep everything.
—
“Don’t worry. I’ll never let you get hurt.”
Without hesitation, Ines threw herself over the cliff.
Her hair, fine as a thread of silver, scattered in the harsh wind.
Her golden eyes, like the Silverdust flower in full bloom, shone with a vivid, unrestrained light.
She would no longer shed weak tears.
She would no longer beg for love just to survive.
Cradling her lower belly in both hands, Inés let her lips curve into a quiet smile.
The rushing current was carrying her towards a new home.
Days later, news reached a man—
Inés de Silverdust was dead.
associated_names: Love You to Tears (Official Tappytoon Manhwa)

127220.synopsis:
A war for the throne, the final demonic calamity, who will write the history?
Unmatched in intellect, a sword’s edge that cannot be hidden, a name to shake the world.
Buddha saves the masses, the Dao establishes its creed, each defending their own domain.
With black and white divided, the trail of heroes grows faint, the martial world is in turmoil.
Here, there are sages who, witnessing “a city of blood and a land of sorrow,” scheme to save the world with a single thought.
Here, there are madmen who, declaring “my name is Nangong, a name that carries hatred,” slaughter their way across the land, undefeated.
Here, there are heroes who, writing “endless regrets in somber verse,” toil day and night in vain.
Here, there are demons who, with “a thought spanning a millennium, I now return,” seek to plunge the mortal realm into chaos.
As legends are still sung, in the darkest of corners—the Silver Locust Ghost Market—a soul that should have vanished unexpectedly sets foot on the th**ny path to seek immortality.

136436.synopsis:
The end of a spy was always death.
“The reason you die… is because of your own incompetence.”
Code name: Cuckoo.
To escape the life of a spy, he once again chooses to walk the path of one.

157684.synopsis:
If a white-haired, beast-eared loli with an unbearably tragic past appeared before you, what would you do?
“Give her meticulous care, heal the wounds in her soul… and then die before her eyes.”
If a girl who dropped out of school to chase her artistic dreams and ended up homeless appeared before you, what would you do?
“Set up a shell talent agency, lure her in, tell her you’re holding a concert just for her—then actually send her to busk in the park.”
If…
“There are not so many ifs.”
Watching the card characters who had all turned dark come knocking at her door, Xu Xiaoyou—grabbed by the collar and lifted off the ground—looked completely helpless.
“I’m just trying to survive… so how did my bad reputation spread throughout the entire supernatural world?”
associated_names: 小姐，您的恶名传遍全诡异！

167924.synopsis:
Jiang Ran has a face so beautiful it’s unforgettable and a painting technique so divine he’s known in the art circle as a “living miracle.” He has money and leisure, yet he has been single since birth.
It’s not that he doesn’t want to date; it’s just that his social circle is too small, he’s a sucker for faces, and he suffers from social anxiety.
Until one day, while searching for inspiration at a newly opened trendy café, Jiang Ran fell in love at first sight with a cold, handsome guy.
The guy had a face that was an affront to God, an icy yet polite temperament, and he even helped the socially anxious Jiang Ran out of an awkward situation. His sleeves were rolled up slightly, revealing smooth and firm muscle lines on his forearms—he was the perfect embodiment of all of Jiang Ran’s fantasies regarding a “repressed, domineering top”!
With his fetishes triggered to the max, Jiang Ran blushed and summoned the greatest courage of his life to ask for the guy’s contact information. However, having never been in a relationship, Jiang Ran had no idea how to flirt, so he turned to his childhood best friend for help.
Best Friend: “You’re asking how to do online dating??” Fearing that Jiang Ran might meet the wrong person, the friend pressed for details: “Who is it? Got a photo? How long have you known him? What are his… conditions?”
Jiang Ran replied shyly: “Just met, no photo, but he’s very good-looking. Conditions…? His hands are wide, his nose is very straight, and he’s about a head and a half taller than me. I feel like his ‘conditions’ shouldn’t be small.”
Best Friend: “I didn’t mean those conditions… forget it ==.”
Since even a face-connoisseur like Jiang Ran said he was handsome, the friend figured it wouldn’t be a loss to date him, so he began plotting.
Best Friend: “Isn’t online dating easy for good-looking people like you? Just be a bit sweet-talky, call him something nice, flirt occasionally, and say some ambiguous things. Be a bit of a ‘Green Tea’—act like it’s nothing and send him some sexy photos. For example, show him your collarbone and say it’s hot. Or wear shorts and show him a mosquito bite on your thigh. Or go for a swim and send a mirror selfie in your swimwear.”
Jiang Ran was shocked: “Ah? That’s so embarrassing…” Best Friend: “What’s the big deal? Isn’t that how online dating works?” Jiang Ran: “Forget it, I’ll just call him ‘Husband’ directly.” Best Friend: “???”
The friend couldn’t understand how a socially anxious person could come up with such a socially suicidal method. Upon further questioning, he learned that Jiang Ran found a “Guide to Snagging Your Male God through Online Dating” on the internet. It claimed that as long as you insist on calling your crush “Husband” every day, over time, the crush will actually start to believe he is your husband. It also claimed this method was simple, effective, and bypassed the awkward “defining the relationship” phase—a true blessing for socially anxious people.
Best Friend: “…Don’t come crying to me when you get blocked.”
